about_the_game:
The Art of Strike Suit Zero

39 pages packed with environments, characters and craft from the world of Strike Suit Zero, with accompanying comments from the art team. The book features technical drawings and artwork from Junji Okubo, including alternative Strike Suits and the original concepts for its design. You’ll get the book at 3 resolutions and file-sizes; 72dpi, 150dpi, and 300dpi.

Art book will be placed in your Strike Suit Zero folder in the Steam Directory: ...Steam\steamapps\common\strike suit zero
